title: Compressed labor
governingQuestion: Does the tool reduce work, relocate it, or make it extractable?
editorialHook: Efficiency for production can become extraction from workers.
longformOutline: Start with the absence of a verified week-wide platform, then report one named workflow from operator and worker perspectives.
verticalScriptBrief: Trace one field—name, measurement, image, availability, or location—through the backstage workflow and ask who controls it.
interactiveSpecification: Backstage Data Inventory: a non-collecting tool showing purpose, owner, retention, subject right, and unresolved deployment evidence.
objectAndRightsBrief: Do not reproduce casting cards or worker data without consent; prioritize a permissioned blank workflow schema.
teachingPrompt: Does digitization reduce labor, relocate it, or make a worker newly machine-readable?
communityCallout: Invite workers to describe systems without submitting personal, client, or confidential data.
accessibilityPlan: Publish transcript/captions for time media; alt text or explicit designed-absence label; keyboard path for the interactive; no status conveyed by color alone.
releaseGates: Every positive claim resolves to cited support
Every media object has item-level rights disposition
Open gaps remain visible in copy and end cards
Named worker/interview consent recorded before quotation
mediaPolicy: OA/licensed/original/authorized embed only; no media cleared in this release
status: day-specific commissioning package; production remains open
